author_direction: Kirk LaSalle approved the literature-constrained axisymmetric parametric-profile family for option 3.

Kirk LaSalle approved: global alpha and global rho0; alpha in [0.5, 2.0]; log10(rho0 / Msun pc^-3) in [-4, 2]; option-2 comparator primary with nested alpha = 1 secondary; per-galaxy f_* in [0.5, 2]; the censoring robustness rule;     10-galaxy primary sample with the 6 CO-profile galaxies as pre-specified secondary.

After an independent pre-freeze review, Kirk LaSalle approved: the full 775-point global grid; the chi2 threshold with 2 N_galaxies degrees of freedom as in option 2; and the disambiguations of inclination, distance, starts, outcome logic, nested clamping, independent secondary refit,         synthetic-profile edges, single application of f_CO, and solver scales.
Kirk LaSalle directed GPU computation (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti) so that the full multistart schedule is run at every grid point; a GPU backend is admissible only through gate V3b.

parent_protocol.unchanged_definition: rho_eff = rho0 (rho_bar / rho0)^(1/alpha) applied after summing stellar, HI and H2 volume densities; nabla^2 Phi = 4 pi G rho_eff; V_c^2 = R dPhi/dR at z = 0 from the full source; no second helium factor

specification_document: docs/EMRF_CANDIDATE_A_OPTION3_RECONSTRUCTION_SPEC_2026-11-04.md (explanatory; this JSON is authoritative where they differ)
registration_scope: Non-blind, post-data-exposure protocol. It is frozen before any option-3 computation that uses observed rotation velocities, not before the data were seen.
prior_knowledge_disclosure: The SPARC rotation curves of these galaxies were analysed in the option-2 test, which rejected option 2.
An exploratory density-table extract on 2026-11-04 printed Leroy Table 4 vflat rotation-curve fit parameters for the 11 overlap galaxies; no statistic was computed.
Bacchini et al. (2019) per-galaxy gas thicknesses, derived with rotation-curve-fitted halos, were seen and are deliberately not used.

sparc.loader: the certified load_sparc primary selection used by candidate-a-option2-sparc-baryonic-v1

excluded.NGC7793: no molecular-gas information of any kind; no bound is available

population.points: SPARC primary-selection points of these galaxies whose catalogue radius lies within the distance-aligned Leroy coverage [R_min, R_max]
population.secondary_rule: the secondary sample is always reported and never changes the primary outcome; disagreement is reported as censoring sensitivity
population.exclusions: No galaxy or point satisfying these rules may be removed after any outcome is computed.

source_reconstruction.geometry: Catalogue radius R = r D_SPARC / D_Leroy; face-on Sigma scaled by cos(i_SPARC) / cos(i_Leroy) once and held fixed during fitting
source_reconstruction.inclination_nuisance: the fitted i enters only through the velocity projection sin(i) / sin(i0); it does not rescale any surface density, as in option 2
source_reconstruction.distance_nuisance: during fitting the source is rebuilt at distance f_D D_SPARC: every source radius, l*, lCO and the stellar z0 scale by f_D, gas thicknesses stay fixed in pc, surface densities are unchanged, and V_c^2 is evaluated at the physical field radii f_D R; no additional sqrt(f_D) factor is applied

radial.interpolation: ln Sigma linear in R between ring centres for positive values; linear in Sigma across a zero end-point
radial.inner: Sigma constant from the innermost ring centre to R = 0
radial.outer: Sigma held at the outermost ring value from the outermost ring centre to the truncation radius R_max + Delta R / 2, Delta R the outermost ring spacing; zero beyond

stellar_disc.vertical: rho = Sigma_* / (2 z0) sech^2(z / z0), z0 = 2 h_z, h_z = h_R / q, radially constant
stellar_disc.flattening: log10 q = 0.367 log10(h_R / kpc) + 0.708 + delta_q, h_R = Leroy l* after distance alignment (Bershady et al. 2010, eq. 1)
stellar_disc.bulge: all stellar mass treated as disc in the primary analysis

gas.vertical: Gaussian, sigma_z = HWHM / sqrt(2 ln 2), radially constant
gas.source: Marasco et al. 2017, A&A 607, A106, Milky Way inside the solar circle

conversion.helium: none applied; Leroy profiles include the 1.36 factor
conversion.stellar_mass_to_light: Sigma_* multiplied by per-galaxy f_* = Upsilon_K / 0.5
conversion.f_CO_application: f_CO multiplies every CO-derived H2 quantity exactly once: measured SigmaH2, the bound U, the no-CO-map global mass and the 5 sigma limit mass; no other factor of 1.3 appears

censoring_and_missing.flag_semantics: a present value with error 1.0 is a measurement with rms 1.0; a blank SigmaHI with error 1.0 is below Leroy's working sensitivity of 1 Msun pc^-2
censoring_and_missing.H2_unmeasured_in_CO_profile_galaxies: interval [0, f_CO U], U = smallest detected SigmaH2 in that galaxy's profile
censoring_and_missing.H2_no_CO_map_global_value: NGC2403, NGC2976: interval from 0 to an exponential profile with scale lCO whose mass inside the truncation radius is f_CO x 1.36 x 10^logMH2 Msun
censoring_and_missing.H2_global_upper_limit: DDO154, IC2574: interval from 0 to an exponential profile with scale l* whose mass inside the truncation radius is f_CO x 1.36 x 10^logMH2 Msun, logMH2 the 5 sigma limit
censoring_and_missing.synthetic_profile_radii: synthetic exponential H2 profiles use the galaxy's HI-and-stellar ring coverage and truncation radius
censoring_and_missing.never: no missing value is replaced by zero except as the labelled low end of an interval

envelopes.low: every interval at its low end and f_CO = 0.7
envelopes.high: every interval at its high end and f_CO = 1.3
envelopes.note: endpoint evaluation is the pre-specified rule; the nonlinear map does not guarantee the statistic is monotone between the ends

validation_gates_before_reading_observed.V1_projection: integral rho_c dz reproduces each component Sigma at every ring centre for both envelopes and every sensitivity variant; relative error < 1e-3
validation_gates_before_reading_observed.V2_helium: no helium factor applied after loading; asserted by test
validation_gates_before_reading_observed.V3_solver: existing Miyamoto-Nagai benchmark and order 64 versus 128 convergence pass; for every galaxy, both envelopes, nominal nuisances, alpha in {0.5, 1, 2} and log10 rho0 in {-4, -1, 2}, max over retained field radii of |V64^2 - V128^2| / max(|V128^2|, 0.01 km^2 s^-2) < 0.005
validation_gates_before_reading_observed.V3b_backend: if a GPU implementation is used, it must reproduce the CPU axisymmetric_v2 reference on every V3 case with max |V_gpu^2 - V_cpu^2| / max(|V_cpu^2|, 0.01 km^2 s^-2) < 1e-10, in float64
validation_gates_before_reading_observed.V4_descriptive: alpha = 1 reconstructed V_bar compared with SPARC Vgas, Vdisk, Vbul model components; descriptive only
validation_gates_before_reading_observed.V5_sensitivity: model-only V_c changes across the sensitivity variants at the V3 grid points, reported before any fit
validation_gates_before_reading_observed.failure: failure of V1, V2, V3 or V3b blocks the fit; outcome incomplete

model.numerics: all arithmetic in float64; an effective density that underflows the float64 range is set to zero; overflow or any non-finite value is an error
model.nuisance_bounds: log10 f_* in [log10 0.5, log10 2]; delta_q in [-0.38, 0.38] dex; f_D and i bounds as in candidate-a-option2-sparc-baryonic-v1
model.a3_prediction: V_A3 = sqrt(max(V_c^2(R; alpha, rho0, x), 0.01 km^2 s^-2)) sin(i) / sin(i0), V_c^2 from axisymmetric_v2 at quadrature order 64 on the rebuilt source, lengths in pc, r_scale = f_D l* in pc, z_scale = 300 pc, G = 4.30091e-3 pc (km/s)^2 / Msun; a negative V_c^2 is an outward force and is floored only inside the square root, as in option 2
model.residual: (V_obs - V_pred) / V_err, V_err floored at 1 km/s
model.reference_comparator_primary: REF = alpha = 1 reconstructed baryons plus the option-2 non-negative pseudo-isothermal term s (1 - (r_c / R)     arctan(R / r_c)), s in [0, 250000] (km/s)^2, log10(r_c / kpc) in [-2, 2], R the catalogue radius as in option 2, added to the alpha = 1 V_c^2 before the sin(i) / sin(i0) projection, with the same per-galaxy nuisances and priors
model.nested_comparator_secondary: N = alpha = 1 reconstructed baryons only, same nuisances; Delta Q_nested = Q_N - Q_A3, with Q_A3 := min(Q_A3, Q_N) so that Delta Q_nested >= 0

treatments.T2_generous_to_A: as T1 without the f_* term

fitting.global_grid: alpha from 0.5 to 2.0 in steps of 0.05 (31 values, including 1.0); log10 rho0 from -4 to 2 in steps of 0.25 (25 values)
fitting.profile: at each grid point minimise each galaxy's Q over its nuisances independently; Q_A3 = min over the grid of the summed Q
fitting.refinement: none; the joint optimum is the grid point with the smallest summed Q (ties resolved by the smallest |alpha - 1|, then the smallest log10 rho0)
fitting.optimizer: scipy.optimize.least_squares, method trf, 3-point finite differences, ftol = xtol = 1e-10, gtol = 1e-9, max_nfev = 2000
fitting.nuisance_starts: log10 f_* in {0, log10 0.5, log10 2} crossed with delta_q in {0, -0.19, 0.19} crossed with (f_D, i) in {(1, i0), (1 + 2 sigma_fD, i0 + 2 sigma_i)}, clipped to the bounds, at every grid point; plus the galaxy's best nuisances at the preceding log10 rho0 grid point of the same alpha row (none for the first point of a row)
fitting.ref_starts: the best alpha = 1 nuisances with s in {0.25, 1} x max(V_obs)^2 and log10 r_c in {log10 0.5, log10 2, log10 8}; plus each f_* start at nominal (delta_q, f_D, i) = (0, 1, i0) with s = max(V_obs)^2 and r_c = 2 kpc
fitting.nesting: Q_REF is the minimum of every converged REF start and Q_N (the s = 0 point)
fitting.convergence: a start counts only if least_squares reports success with a finite cost; every galaxy, grid point, model, treatment and envelope cell needs at least one counted start
fitting.secondary_sample: the secondary sample is analysed by an independent complete refit of the global grid, nuisances, comparators and statistics on its own galaxies
fitting.boundary_annotation: a best-fit alpha or rho0 on a domain edge is reported as a boundary result

statistics.per_galaxy: Delta_Q_i = Q_i(A3 at the joint optimum) - Q_i(REF)
statistics.error_inflation: lambda = max(1, chi2_data(REF) summed over the population / max(N_points - 6 N_galaxies, 1)), separately per treatment and envelope; 6 = four nuisances plus the two REF halo parameters per galaxy
statistics.population_threshold: 0.999 quantile of chi2 with 2 N_galaxies degrees of freedom, as in option 2; the parameter-count difference is 2 N_galaxies - 2, so this choice is slightly lenient toward A3
statistics.calibration_caveat: Thresholds are nominal, as in option 2. A3 and REF are non-nested, the comparator has boundary parameters, radial covariance is unknown, and the objective includes priors; these are not calibrated significances.

outcome_rules.definition: for the primary sample and envelope e in {low, high}, E_e is true when Delta_Q_cons exceeds the population threshold under both T1 and T2
outcome_rules.not_determinable_censoring: exactly one of E_low and E_high
outcome_rules.incomplete: a data hash mismatch, a failed V1, V2, V3 or V3b gate, a cell without a counted start, or any non-finite value; stop and report

reported_descriptives: best (alpha, rho0) per treatment and envelope, with boundary annotation
Delta_Q_nested for the secondary nested comparator
the same statistics for the secondary CO-profile sample
sensitivity_never_the_result: HI and H2 HWHM at their 1 sigma ends (174/230 pc and 52/76 pc)
hydrostatic flaring gas thickness sigma_z,g(R) = sigma_g / sqrt(4 pi G rho_bar(R, 0)) iterated to self-consistency, sigma_HI = 8.9 and sigma_H2 = 4.4 km/s
inward exponential stellar continuation with scale l*
outer exponential tails using each component's mean log-slope over its last three positive rings
spherical inner bulge: excess of Sigma_* above an exponential disc of scale l* normalised at R = 2 l*, deprojected by Abel inversion
T1 with the f_* prior centred at Upsilon_K = 0.4 and 0.6
interpretation_limits: A rejection falsifies only this option-3 operationalization with this reconstruction family, not Candidate A in general.
A non-rejection would not confirm Candidate A; nonunit alpha still fails the GR gate without an additional source or modified dynamics.
The reconstruction is a literature-constrained model assumption, not a measured three-dimensional density.
The test is non-blind; see prior_knowledge_disclosure.
Non-circular motions, warps and asymmetric drift are not modelled.
